section.title: Tools loaded on demand
section.subtitle: Pay for documentation only on tools you use: write/exec and MCP tools are withdrawn, read tools always stay
field.persistent.label: The three tools that always stay
field.deferMcpSchemas.label: Withdraw MCP tools too
field.deferMcpSchemas.help: One MCP server brings dozens of tool schemas, so this pays off most. Turn it off and the write/exec tools go back on the table at once, with no restart.
field.tier.label: Withdrawal tier
field.tier.option.2: 2: also withdraw tools matched by the rules below (default)
field.tier.option.3: 3: withdraw every tool that changes things, except the keep list
field.tier.help: Only write / exec tools are withdrawn; read tools always stay on the table.
field.deferRules.label: Deferral rules (one per line, * allowed)
field.deferRules.help: Only applies at tier 2. A matched tool is withdrawn and has to be called through tool_call, and each call asks for approval under that tool's real name.
field.keepTools.label: Tools that always stay on the table (one per line)
field.keepTools.help: Applies at tiers 2 and 3. Put tools you use often and do not want routed through tool_call here.
field.searchLimit.label: Maximum results per search
field.searchLimit.help: The model can pass its own limit to tool_search; this is the cap.
field.withheld.label: Withdrawn right now
field.withheld.help: The config lives in the {key} entry of {file}; editing it by hand works too.
field.withheld.empty: Nothing is withdrawn right now: the whole registry stays on the table.{note}
field.withheld.emptyNote: (the MCP switch is off, so MCP tool schemas are not withdrawn)
field.withheld.mcpOff: MCP tool schemas are not withdrawn (the switch is off)
field.withheld.keepRead: Read tools never appear in those two lines: withdrawing them would add two round trips to every read and save little.
field.current.label: Current config
save.badSwitch: This switch can only be on or off.
save.badTier: The tier can only be 1, 2 or 3, got {value}.
save.badLimit: The count must be between {min} and {max}, got {value}.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
